request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols, including protocol onboardings, developer and agent coverage, an MCP server, and a skill framework.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The proposal says Tx3 will provide an open, standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols so developers and AI agents can discover, integrate, and compose protocols through a single consistent surface.
The proposal asserts there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and increasing integration cost.
The proposal states Tx3 describes each protocol once with a verified interface definition and produces documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
The proposal claims TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production through Catalyst Fund 14 with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at https://tx3.land.
The proposal says 12 additional protocol onboardings will be funded, at 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal states audit and oversight costs are included in overhead, with Intersect and technically capable third parties providing reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule, plus Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month TxPipe Tx3 expansion, asserting ecosystem need for standardized protocol interfaces and agent-ready infrastructure, with some checkable governance and registry references but limited internal budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode detail.
